test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-II (Held On: 08 Jan, 2024)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to improve the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no improvement required, select ‘No improvement’.

Passengers traveling by air __are prohibited to carry__ sharp objects in cabin baggage.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the sentence, the phrase "to carry" is incorrect and needs to be replaced.
 
• The correct phrase should be **"prohibited from carrying"** to convey the intended meaning.
 
• The phrase **"prohibited from"** is used to indicate that something is not allowed.
 
• **Example:** *Passengers are** prohibited from** using mobile phones during the flight.*

Hence the correct statement is '*Passengers traveling by air are** prohibited from **carrying sharp objects in cabin baggage*.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The phrase **"prohibited from"** is commonly used in formal writing and legal contexts to specify what actions are not allowed.

 
 
• **Example:** *Students are **prohibited from** bringing food into the library.*
